note: Fishing resort on the South Dakota shore of Big Stone Lake, with lakeside suites and a campground set back from the shore behind them. The rows look largely seasonal; the operator's site posts no camping rates or nightly-site information. Swimming beach, private launch, docks, fish cleaning station, boat and pontoon rentals, free kayaks and pedal boats (Memorial Day to Labor Day). --Claude
